subject: FrescoHealth vendor creation — PO fields, bank remit, and VAT/GST split
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@frescohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: FrescoHealth vendor creation — PO fields, bank remit, and VAT/GST split

Hi Amit,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. To get Redwood created as a vendor in FrescoHealth's AP system and ensure future invoices link cleanly to POs, I've summarized the minimal data and evidence your portal needs. I attached our AP onboarding packet and a filled VAT annex for your review.

Required for vendor creation / PO matching (recommended minimal set):
- Legal company name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Primary remit bank account (IBAN + SWIFT) and payee name
- Billing address used for VAT registration (we have EU VAT registration under Redwood Inference EU Sàrl)
- Legal entity / tax ID to appear on the vendor record (VAT ID: EU-987654321)
- Preferred invoice reference: PO number in invoice header and invoice-level custom field PO_REF
- E-invoice/UBL support: PDF + optional UBL XML attachment (we can produce UBL if you require it)
- Contact for AP questions (name + email + phone) and billing contact for reconciliation

On VAT/GST treatment you raised: for EU invoices where FrescoHealth issues a PO to Redwood EU entity, we expect VAT to be included as per the PO terms. If FrescoHealth requires reverse-charge, please set the PO tax flag and include the VAT regime code in the PO metadata — we will then issue invoices with net amounts and reference the reverse-charge article.

Banking and payer instructions:
- Remit to: Redwood Inference EU Sàrl
- IBAN: BE12 3456 7890 1234
- SWIFT/BIC: RBCBE22
- Please confirm preferred remit currency (EUR is our default for EU legal entity)

Next steps I propose:
1) You create the vendor record with fields above; send back the vendor ID you generate.
2) We will upload the signed W9/VAT annex and the onboarding packet to your portal (attached).
3) We'll coordinate one test invoice referencing a dummy PO (FCS-TEST-001) to validate PO matching and remit routing.

Attached: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.3.pdf (AP packet), W9_or_VAT_Annex_Template.xlsx (completed VAT annex)

If it helps, Marissa can join a quick 30-min screen share to walk through your portal fields.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the summary — that's helpful. A few quick clarifying questions before we create the vendor in our ERP:

1) Do you have multiple legal entities in EU vs US? Which one should appear on the vendor record for purchase orders?
2) If we set up a vendor record for the EU entity, can you confirm whether Redwood will accept consolidated invoices from the US entity (for cross-border services) or whether you prefer per-entity invoicing?
3) For reverse-charge, what exact wording do you want on the invoice (we have limited free-text space in our UBL fields)?

Also attaching a copy of our vendor creation form — our tax team asked for the vendor legal address and the VAT certificate PDF.

Amit Shah
Sr. Manager, Global Procurement
FrescoHealth
phone: +44 20 7946 0101

On Thu, Jul 15, 2026 at 13:02 +0200 Amit Shah wrote:
> Hi Dylan,
>
> Thanks for the summary — that's helpful. A few quick clarifying questions before we create the vendor in our ERP:
>
> 1) Do you have multiple legal entities in EU vs US? Which one should appear on the vendor record for purchase orders?
> 2) If we set up a vendor record for the EU entity, can you confirm whether Redwood will accept consolidated invoices from the US entity (for cross-border services) or whether you prefer per-entity invoicing?
> 3) For reverse-charge, what exact wording do you want on the invoice (we have limited free-text space in our UBL fields)?

Hi Amit — great questions, answered inline below:

1) Legal entities: for procurement and PO routing please use Redwood Inference EU Sàrl (the EU legal entity) when the PO is issued by FrescoHealth EU. For US-based POs, use Redwood Inference, Inc. For now, default to the EU entity for all FrescoHealth POs originating in the EU.

2) Invoicing preference: we strongly prefer per-entity invoicing that matches the PO issuer. If cross-border services are involved and FrescoHealth wants a single consolidated invoice, we can support that but will need a cross-entity billing agreement and a specific remit workflow. For the initial go-live, please keep one PO -> one invoice from the matching legal entity.

3) Reverse-charge wording: use the standard UBL tax note field and include: "Reverse charge — Article 44(1) of Council Directive 2006/112/EC applies; VAT to be accounted for by the recipient." If you must shorten for a fixed field, include: "Reverse charge — recipient liable."

I attached our VAT certificate for the EU entity and the AP onboarding packet again. If your tax team prefers an alternate phrasing we can adapt.

Attachments: Redwood_VAT_cert_EU.pdf, Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.3.pdf

Best,

Dylan

We've created the vendor record: FH-VND-45892. A couple of notes from our tax and AP teams:

- We flagged the vendor for VAT verification; our tax team will confirm the EU VAT certificate (we have the PDF you attached).
- For UBL, our system can only accept a 120-char tax note field, so we used: "Reverse charge — recipient liable. See contract for details."

We completed a single test PO (PO-FH-20260717-001). Please issue a test invoice referencing that PO to invoices@frescohealth.com so we can validate PO matching and payment routing.
